description: React component for displaying a linked item bubble with interactive features such as focus, unlink, and icon display, used within a web application's UI.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the linked item and shows the unlink button.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Hides the unlink button and resets click state when the component loses focus.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the bubble, activating the linked item if clicked.

methods.name: onUnlinkClick
methods.description: Triggers unlinking of the item when the unlink button is clicked.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation and unlinking via Backspace, Left, and Right keys.
